name: Reasoning
description: What the model was thinking, folded away.

props.name: label
props.description: The header's words. Default `Reasoning`, or `Thinking…` while `streaming`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open. Default `false` — a chain of thought is an aside, not the answer.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the header is pressed.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Still arriving: the header says so and shimmers. Opening it is the app's — pass `open={streaming}`.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the thought took, in milliseconds. Rendered beside the label as "Thought for 4s".

keyboard.action: Focuses the header, and again leaves it.
Opens the thought, or closes it.

a11y: The header is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the thought itself has no role, because a region wants a name and a disclosure's trigger is not a heading.
